title: Portfolio Delivery Director
jobDescription:
Job Summary Role Purpose The Delivery Head – India Business will be responsible for managing end-to-end delivery across a portfolio of India-based customer accounts for an IT Services / IT Outsourcing organization. The role will own delivery excellence, revenue achievement, customer satisfaction, account growth support, team scalability, and operational governance. The ideal candidate would be a strong portfolio delivery leader currently working with a Tier-2 IT Services company in India, managing multiple customer accounts, delivery teams, and business commitments. Key Responsibilities Delivery & Program Management
- Lead delivery across multiple programs, projects, and managed services engagements for India-based customers.
- Ensure agreed deliverables are met in terms of time, cost, quality, scope, and contractual commitments.
- Establish strong governance across accounts, including delivery reviews, risk tracking, issue resolution, and escalation management.
- Drive predictability in delivery through proactive planning, resource management, quality control, and stakeholder communication.
- Ensure adherence to SLAs, KPIs, delivery milestones, and customer expectations. Business & Revenue Management
- Own revenue delivery targets for the assigned India customer portfolio.
- Support achievement of business results through delivery excellence, customer retention, and account expansion.
- Assist Sales and Account teams in business development, account mining, bid defense, proposal reviews, and contract reviews.
- Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts and help initiate potential new customer projects.
- Ensure delivery operations support revenue realization, margin goals, and profitable growth. Customer Relationship & Engagement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with senior customer stakeholders across assigned accounts.
- Act as the delivery owner and escalation point for customer delivery matters.
- Ensure high customer satisfaction, customer retention, and referencability.
- Conduct regular governance meetings, account reviews, and delivery performance discussions.
- Partner with Account and Sales teams to strengthen customer relationships and support business growth. People Leadership & Capability Building
- Work closely with HR, recruitment, and resource management teams to fulfill project and account staffing needs.
- Build and scale delivery teams in line with business growth.
- Guide, mentor, and develop project managers, delivery managers, architects, technical leads, and engineering teams.
- Drive performance management, capability development, employee engagement, and retention.
- Create a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement. Process Excellence & Compliance
- Anchor process improvement, delivery compliance, and organizational initiatives across the portfolio.
- Ensure adherence to internal delivery frameworks, quality standards, security requirements, and customer-specific processes.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve productivity, quality, delivery efficiency, and customer experience.
- Monitor delivery health through metrics, dashboards, audits, and governance mechanisms. Key Responsibilities Scope of Responsibility
- Meeting revenue targets for the assigned India business portfolio.
- Delivering projects and services as per contractual commitments.
- Maintaining strong customer relationships across India-based accounts.
- Ensuring customer satisfaction and customer referencability.
- Supporting business expansion through mining of existing accounts.
- Partnering with Sales and Account teams for customer growth.
- Building and expanding delivery teams as business scales.
- Managing delivery performance, risks, escalations, and governance. Required Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
- 18+ years of experience in IT Services, IT Consulting, or IT Outsourcing.
- Strong experience in delivery management, program management, and portfolio management.
- Experience managing multiple India-based customer accounts with revenue, delivery, and customer satisfaction accountability.
- Proven ability to manage large delivery teams across application development, maintenance, digital, cloud, data, or managed services engagements.
- Experience in supporting proposals, bid defense, solution reviews, contract reviews, and account growth initiatives.
- Strong understanding of delivery governance, project financials, resource management, quality processes, and risk management. Preferred Candidate Profile
- Currently working in India with a Tier-2 Indian IT Services / IT Outsourcing company.
- Currently managing a portfolio of customer accounts with end-to-end delivery responsibility.
- Could be operating as a Portfolio Manager, Delivery Director, Program Director, Senior Delivery Manager, or Account Delivery Leader.
- Should have started the career from a technical background and grown into delivery leadership.
- Strong technology acumen with the ability to engage with technical teams, architects, business stakeholders, and customer leadership.
- Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Demonstrated ability to manage delivery outcomes, customer satisfaction, team performance, and business growth together. Key Competencies
- Portfolio Delivery Management
- Customer Relationship Management
- Revenue and Margin Orientation
- Program and Project Governance
- Account Mining and Growth Support
- Team Building and People Leadership
- Technology Acumen
- Risk and Escalation Management
- Process Compliance and Continuous Improvement
- Strong Executive Communication Key Success Metrics
- Revenue Achievement
- Gross Margin / Profitability
- Customer Satisfaction
- Customer Referencability
- SLA and KPI Compliance
- On-time and On-budget Delivery
- Account Growth Support
- Resource Utilization
- Delivery Quality
- Employee Engagement and Retention Compliance and Governance Adherence Skill Requirements null Other Requirements null

title: Facility Services - IV
jobDescription: Job Summary Role Summary – EP supports the Head of Executive Protection by running day-to-day EP program operations, with a strong focus on documentation, reporting, and operational governance. The role manages third-party security workforce (guards, EP drivers, control room) through the vendor point of contact (POC) and coordinates with internal stakeholders to ensure consistent, compliant delivery of EP services.Key Boundary• This role does NOT directly communicate with Principals/CXOs. All Principal-facing communication is handled by the Head – EP Program.Reporting & Location• Reports to: Head – Executive Protection Program (Corporate Security)• Location: Delhi-NCR• Travel: Pan-India travel may be required on short notice when the Head – EP is unavailable Key Responsibilities• Own EP program documentation: SOPs, post orders, checklists, rosters, escalation matrix, training records, equipment logs.• Ensure third-party workforce management through vendor POC: deployment accuracy, attendance, discipline, grooming/turnout, replacements, SLA adherence.• Coordinate operations with internal stakeholders (Corporate Security, Facilities/Workplace, Admin, Travel/Transport) to enable EP readiness and smooth execution.• Support audits/assessments (residence/venues/temporary stays) as assigned; track action items and closures.• Support incident response as per escalation matrix; document incidents, prepare after-action reports.• Support training/drills administration and readiness checks for corporate guards, PSOs, EPOs and control room resources.• Provide on-ground operational support during pan-India movements/events as assigned.Success Measures (KPIs)• On-time, high-quality reporting and documentation hygiene (SOPs, logs, trackers kept current).• High roster/deployment adherence and minimal service exceptions.• Incident reports.• Stakeholder action items closed within agreed timelines.• Training/drill schedules executed with documented evidence and improvements. Experience & Qualifications• 8+ years in Executive Protection / VIP Protection OR Armed Forces with VIP protection exposure (e.g., SPG/NSG/VIP protection duties or equivalent).• Experience managing third-party security workforce and control room operations through SOPs and vendor governance.• Strong documentation and reporting skills (SOP writing, incident reporting, dashboards).• Good stakeholder coordination and follow-through.• High integrity, confidentiality, and professional conduct.Key Skills• Strong written communication and attention to detail.• Operational discipline and vendor management.• Incident documentation and structured problem-solving.• Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities• MS Excel/Power Point for reporting. Confidentiality Maintains strict confidentiality and handles sensitive information on a need-to-know basis, in line with company policy and applicable laws.

title: SME - NetApp FAS, EMC Isilion
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Senior Net App Storage Administrator (L3) designs, implements, and maintains global enterprise storage infrastructure. This role provides expert-level engineering support, ensures high availability, and drives automation for Net App ONTAP systems and AWS FSx Key Responsibilities Architecture & Engineering: Design and deploy multi-cluster Net App AFF/FAS environments. Protocol Management: Optimize performance for SAN (FC, i SCSI) and NAS (NFS, CIFS) protocols. Disaster Recovery: Implement and test Snap Mirror, Snap Vault, and Metro Cluster strategies. Capacity Planning: Predict growth trends and manage storage lifecycle upgrades. Automation: Create Ansible playbooks or Python scripts to automate provisioning tasks .Performance Tuning: Troubleshoot complex latency and IOPS bottlenecks using Active IQ Unified Manager. Security & Compliance: Enforce Net App volume encryption (NVE) and ransomware protection policies. Escalation Support: Serve as the highest technical tier for critical storage outages (24/7). title: Senior Administrator - Program & Project Management
jobDescription:
Job Summary Support Account Manager for Service Now. Technical project manager’s or Service Now functional consultants, Critical Incident Managers with Service Now experience will be apt for this role.
- Looking for managers in between 6 to 10 year’s experience.
- This is work from office role all 5 days from customer office.
- Good communication skills, customer management experience, understanding of ITIL and Service Now platform. Key Responsibilities Use industry leading software management tools to proactively identify potential degradation of service issues to mitigate and/or resolve business impacting events for customers. • Deliver business value and solutions by understanding and aligning Service Now applications, features, and benefits as it relates to our customer needs. • Drive/ensure the continual flow of information with timely updates on all open cases, changes, problems, and on-going projects. • Facilitate summary status reports, including monthly performance reviews and quarterly service reviews. • Act as the facilitator between customers and Service Now with reference to mandatory upgrades, patches, and security requirements. • Manage, document and report on performance against service level agreements (SLA\'s) and where SLA’s are not being met document and oversee an action plan that will result in meeting and exceeding those commitments routinely. • Drive continual improvement for the customer and their environment through trend analysis and partnering with the internal team to be a champion of change. • Review open cases, problems and changes communicating aligned priorities to assigned Service Now teams to ensure a timely response and resolution. Skill Requirements Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI\'s potential impact on the function or industry. • 5-10 yrs of experience with 2+ years of customer-facing experience • Flexible and ready to work in India morning or late evening shift to present on handover calls with the incoming and outgoing regions. • Ready to work on weekends. • Prior Service Now implementation knowledge and Service Now certifications would be an added advantage. • Excellent written and oral communication skills • Experience dealing with technical support teams • Fundamental understanding of ITSM in enterprise and global deployments • Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and release management process • Ability to effectively work with tight schedules and fast paced environment to minimize problem impact on the customer within a global model • Broad technical understanding in a cloud software environment • Automation/tech skillset – UX, Web services, Testing, Requirements, documentation Other Requirements Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI\'s potential impact on the function or industry. • 5-10 yrs of experience with 2+ years of customer-facing experience • Flexible and ready to work in India morning or late evening shift to present on handover calls with the incoming and outgoing regions. • Ready to work on weekends. • Prior Service Now implementation knowledge and Service Now certifications would be an added advantage. • Excellent written and oral communication skills • Experience dealing with technical support teams • Fundamental understanding of ITSM in enterprise and global deployments • Working knowledge of ITIL incident, problem and release management process • Ability to effectively work with tight schedules and fast paced environment to minimize problem impact on the customer within a global model • Broad technical understanding in a cloud software environment • Automation/tech skillset – UX, Web services, Testing, Requirements, documentation

Job Summary ROLE DESCRIPTION. SERVICE DESK DOMAIN LEADER (EUROPEAN DWP MSI TEAM) CONTEXT The Service Desk is often described as the “window on IT” and, as such, its performance has a significant impact on the overall operation and perception of the IT department. The Service Desk Domain Leader will play a critical role in defining the future way in which we delivery and manage the service, emphasising radical and innovative change rather than incremental improvement  The role will be based in the Poland Delivery Centre in Krakow. The role will demand frequent travel with Europe and often further afield.  The Service Desk Domain Leader will manage a small team of domain experts, based mainly in India. ROLES AND RESPONSIBLITIES The primary objectives of the role are  Build a Service Desk community within Strategic Focus Accounts to create a culture and environment where cross-account and cross-function collaboration, innovation and excellence is the norm.  Within Strategic Focus Accounts help Delivery teams achieve their BAU customer satisfaction, service excellence and commercial performance targets.  Define the future road-map for the Service Desk. Develop, communicate and lead the execution of innovative transformational projects focused on taking the Service Desk to the next level of performance.  Build strong and lasting relationships with internal and external customers, and key delivery partners by meeting with them on a regular basis to listen to their needs and concerns, to discuss our service roadmaps and evangelise HCL capability.  Align our Service Desk processes, technology and solutions to meet the client business requirements on a continual basis & foster solution innovation to solve client issues.  Support Sales in creation of solutions, RFP responses, SOW reviews and participating in bid defence workshops. KEY SKILLS  A detailed, practical and broad knowledge of Service Desk operations, delivery models and technology solutions  Extensive experience of delivery, transition and transformation of complex, multichannel, global Service Desks  Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; confident to engage with senior stakeholders in customer and supplier organizations. A strong character, capable of defining and implemented large and highly impactful change programmes Key Responsibilities ROLE DESCRIPTION. This role is ideal for professionals who excel in SQL Server administration and cloud integration. The successful candidate will lead SQL Server initiatives including high availability, performance tuning, and cloud migration, monitoring, and Deployment configurations. Key Responsibilities SQL Server Lead installation, configuration, and maintenance of SQL Server instances (2016/2019/2022) in on-prem and Azure environments. Design and implement High Availability solutions including Always On Availability Groups, Failover Clustering, and Geo-replication in Azure. Perform performance tuning using DMVs, Query Store, Extended Events, and Database Tuning Advisor. Manage SQL Server Agent jobs, linked servers, and database mail. Oversee database migrations, upgrades, and patching. Implement robust backup and recovery strategies using native tools and Azure Backup. Ensure database security through role-based access, encryption, and auditing. Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to optimize database performance and troubleshoot issues. Maintain documentation including SOPs, DR plans, and capacity reports. Expertise in Always On, Clustering, performance tuning, and security. Familiarity with Azure services like Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Monitor, and Azure Backup. Proficiency in Power Shell and T-SQL scripting. Soft Skills Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Preferred Certifications Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate or equivalent. jobDescription: Job Summary Service Now Support Account Manager . Customer facing Service Now account manager who has prior experience on Service Now platform. Key Responsibilities Service Now is seeking highly motivated and professional individuals to join our Support Account Management (SAM) Services team and play a critical role in delivering world-class customer satisfaction, as SAMs help Service Now change the way people work. The SAM will be delivering both proactive and reactive services and act as a central point of contact for all support-related activities. You will be a member of a highly skilled team focused on a select set of high profile, strategic customers whilst delivering a high-quality service. • Use industry leading software management tools to proactively identify potential degradation of service issues to mitigate and/or resolve business impacting events for customers. • Deliver business value and solutions by understanding and aligning Service Now applications, features, and benefits as it relates to our customer needs. • Drive/ensure the continual flow of information with timely updates on all open cases, changes, problems, and on-going projects. • Facilitate summary status reports, including monthly performance reviews and quarterly service reviews. • Act as the facilitator between customers and Service Now with reference to mandatory upgrades, patches, and security requirements. • Manage, document and report on performance against service level agreements (SLA\'s) and where SLA’s are not being met document and oversee an action plan that will result in meeting and exceeding those commitments routinely. • Drive continual improvement for the customer and their environment through trend analysis and partnering with the internal team to be a champion of change. • Review open cases, problems and changes communicating aligned priorities to assigned Service Now teams to ensure a timely response and resolution. To be successful in this role, we need someone who has: • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. QUALIFICATIONS:
B.E. Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation/Mining/Production Experience: 8-12 Years Location: PAN India Industry: Oil & Gas, Chemical, Mining, Utility & Manufacturing Job Description: Experience with EAM, CMMS, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP PM, MM, Maximo, Infor, JD Edwards). Professional Experience in Asset Management and MDM System Evaluation and Consulting Experience in Digital Transformation & Digital Twin. Predictive maintenance in smart factories using advanced technologies. Development and management of Maintenance Master Data, including Functional Location, Equipment, Bill of Materials, Measuring Points, Counters, Maintenance Tasklists, Items and Plans, PM Materials, and Assembly; as well as validation of classification criteria. Knowledge to read and understand the engineering drawings and systems with integration Knowledge of asset hierarchy, classification, performance management, and inventory optimization. Soft Skills: Attention to detail, analytical ability, problem solving, cross-functional collaboration, focus on continuous improvement, and multi-tasking. Job Summary Job Description: Architect – Crypto Key Protect L3 Overview We are seeking an experienced Architect for the Crypto Key Protect L3 team to join our organization in Pune or Hyderabad, India. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining advanced cryptographic key protection solutions. This role is crucial for ensuring the security and integrity of sensitive data across our enterprise systems. Key Responsibilities Design and architect scalable, secure, and robust cryptographic key protection solutions for enterprise applications. Lead the development and implementation of cryptographic protocols, including key management, storage, and rotation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (security, engineering, operations) to integrate crypto key protection into existing and new systems. Conduct security assessments and reviews to identify vulnerabilities and recommend mitigation strategies. Provide Level 3 (L3) technical support and troubleshooting for cryptographic key management systems. Develop and maintain documentation, including architecture diagrams, design specifications, and operational procedures. Stay updated on industry standards, best practices, and emerging technologies in cryptography and cybersecurity. Mentor and guide junior engineers and team members on best practices in cryptographic key management. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in security architecture, cryptography, or related roles. Expertise in designing and implementing cryptographic key management systems and protocols. Hands-on experience with HSMs (Hardware Security Modules), PKI, and secure key storage solutions. Strong understanding of encryption, digital signatures, certificate management, and key lifecycle management. Experience providing L3 technical support in enterprise environments. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Familiarity with compliance standards such as PCI DSS, GDPR, and ISO
27001. Proficiency in scripting or programming languages (Python, Java, C++, etc.) is a plus. Preferred Skills Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-based key management solutions. Knowledge of Dev Sec Ops practices and automation tools. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or relevant cryptography certifications. Experience working with global, distributed teams.

jobDescription:
Job Summary Technical support L2+ or L3 on data integration and SAP's CPI. Working normal office hours. 9:00
- 18:00 local India time. Role description
- Provide L2+ technical support for SAP CPI, SQL, and SSIS-based integrations, including incident resolution, monitoring of data pipelines, root cause analysis, and coordination with L3 teams to ensure reliable end-to-end data integration and system stability Qualification SAP CPI & Integration Expertise • Hands-on experience with: o SAP Integration Suite / CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) o Interface technologies: REST, SOAP, IDoc, OData • Understanding of: o i Flows, message routing, adapters o Error handling and reprocessing SQL / Database Skills • Strong hands-on experience with: o SQL queries and data analysis o Stored procedures and database troubleshooting • Ability to: o Investigate data inconsistencies o Perform basic query optimisation o Analyse database logs and performance issues SSIS / ETL Knowledge • Practical experience with: o SSIS packages and ETL workflows o Job scheduling and batch processing • Ability to: o Troubleshoot job failures and restart processes o Analyse ETL logs and identify root causes Key Responsibilities
1. Implement and configure sap cloud platform integration (cpi) for seamless integration between various modules within the erp system.
2. Develop and maintain integration solutions to meet business requirements and improve system efficiency.
3. Collaborate with cross functional teams to analyze integration requirements and design effective solutions.
4. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flow, system interfaces, and integration processes.
5. Ensure compliance with best practices and standards in erp integration and data management.
6. Provide technical support and training to end-users on sap cpi integration processes and functionalities. Skill Requirements
1. Strong knowledge of sap cloud platform integration (cpi) and its integration capabilities.
2. Proficiency in sap erp modules and system architecture.
3. Experience in designing and implementing integration solutions using sap cpi.
4. Ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to integration processes.
5. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
6. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities to work effectively with cross functional teams.
7. Relevant sap certifications in sap cloud platform integration (cpi) or erp modules would be a plus. Other Requirements 1.Relevant SAP certifications in SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) or ERP modules would be a plus. Job Description SAP BTP

jobDescription:
Job Summary SME & Architect Data Center Cooling Infrastructure , HCBU, HCLTech www.hcltech.com Noida India & US, 1 Position each / 10-12 Years Experience / E4 / Full-Time We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 220,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. The driving force behind that work, our people, are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence on a regular basis. We, in turn, work hard to bring out the best in them as we strive to help them find their spark and become the best version of themselves that they can be. If all this sounds like an environment you’ll thrive in, then you’re in the right place. Join us on our journey in advancing the technological world through innovation and creativity. The Role The Co E – AI Data Center Cooling Design & Build is a global Center-of-Excellence role responsible for defining, standardizing, and governing thermal management architectures for next-generation AI-ready and hyperscale data centers. This role serves as the technical authority for mission-critical cooling systems and ensures designs are scalable, energy-efficient, resilient, and aligned with hyperscaler and sustainability expectations. The position translates high-density AI heat loads into optimized cooling solutions covering air-based and liquid-based technologies, including chilled water systems, DX systems, rear-door heat exchangers, direct-to-chip liquid cooling, and immersion cooling. The role establishes global cooling reference architectures, standardized design frameworks, and deployment playbooks to enable repeatable global builds. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Define and govern global cooling design standards for AI and hyperscale data centers • Develop end-to-end thermal management architectures for high-density environments • Translate GPU and AI workload heat profiles into optimized cooling designs • Lead design and adoption of liquid cooling technologies (D2C, RDHx, immersion) • Develop cooling redundancy models such as N+1, 2N, and distributed cooling • Create standardized cooling design templates and engineering toolkits • Review and approve cooling system schematics and layouts • Define water management, leak detection, and mitigation strategies • Lead cooling design risk assessments and mitigation planning • Validate OEM cooling equipment selection and interoperabil Key Responsibilities
1. To Facilitate The Readiness And Availability Of Gtm Propositions, Offering Maps, Coordinating With Different Teams Including Marketing, To Align With The Specific Needs Of Business Units.
2. To Oversee The Creation And Formalization Of Case Studies, Ensuring They Are Suitably Developed Into Gtm Collateral To Effectively Illustrate Success Stories And Testimonials.
3. To Gather Insights On Prevailing Industry Developments And Analyze Competitor Strategies And Specific Account Details To Inform Business Decisions.
4. To Collaborate With Sales Team (Hunting & Farming) On Key Focus Areas & Customer Profiles.
5. To Implement Improvements Based On The Evaluation To Enhance The Effectiveness And Relevance Of Collateral, Ensuring It Meets Market Demands And Supports Business Growth. Skill Requirements null Other Requirements null

Monitor ETL jobs and data pipelines for failures, performance issues, and data discrepancies.Provide timely and effective first-line and second-line support for all ETL-related incidents, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.Diagnose root causes of issues, implement immediate fixes, and propose long-term solutions to prevent recurrence.Escalate complex issues to development teams or senior management as required, while actively tracking resolutions.Analyze recurring incidents to identify underlying problems and systemic weaknesses in ETL processes.Develop and implement permanent solutions, automation scripts, and process enhancements to improve stability and efficiency.Regularly monitor the performance of ETL jobs, databases, and servers involved in data integration.Identify bottlenecks and propose/implement optimizations to improve data load times and overall system efficiency.Maintain and update ETL process documentation, including runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles. Required Skills and

QUALIFICATIONS:
Experience : Minimum of 5 years of experience in ETL support, data warehousing, or data engineering roles. ETL Tools : Proficient experience with at least one major ETL tool (e.g., Informatica Power Center, Talend, Microsoft SSIS, Data Stage, Oracle Data Integrator, Apache Ni Fi). Database Expertise : Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, analyzing, and troubleshooting data issues in relational databases (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, Postgre SQL, My SQL). Experience with data warehousing concepts (Star Schema, Snowflake Schema). Scripting : Hands-on experience with scripting languages (e.g., Shell Scripting, Python) for automation, data manipulation, and troubleshooting. EDUCATION:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. title: Buyer
jobDescription:
Job Summary To buy for a region or a customer ensuring requirements for speed, cost, and quality are met Key Responsibilities
- Work as a part of Global Procurement team reporting to Category lead for all procurement under MRO/infra/AMC/RE category.
- To negotiate and close commercials & Terms/conditions related to MRO/ Infra/AMC and Renewable Energy activities with potential partners.
- Ownership of partner Onboarding and Contract Management (SOW, MSA, NDA, Commercial Agreements & similar legal & subcontracting agreements)
- Responsible for identifying partners, floating RFI/RFP, arranging bidding for supply of required product as per SOW defined by user.
- To ensure closure of all commercials transaction/partner finalisation as per HCL procurement Policy.
- To benchmark commercials against current market trends and earlier purchase transactions.
- Facilitate communication with/between partners, users and other stakeholders for technical discussions and partner evaluation.
- Ensure approval notes for partner selection are prepared with supporting documentation and signed as per DOA.
- To ensure that partner’s product abides by all environmental safety awareness and compliances.
- Track new requests received on daily basis to ensure timely action and its closure.
- To prepare MIS and ageing report on periodic basis.
- To conduct spend analysis to identify cost saving and partner consolidation opportunities.
- Follow up with the vendors to ensure timely delivery of material. Levy penalty in case of delays.
- Maintain proper documentation for receipt of quotes, proposals, cost analysis sheets, partner technical evaluation, management approval etc from compliance point of view.
- Handle periodic audit queries on transaction closed and provide data/reply in response.
- Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Skill Requirements
- Good Commercial Acumen.
- Knowledge of sourcing and procurement techniques and dexterity in “reading” the market.
- Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially Outlook, Power Point, Excel, SAP, Ariba.
- Aptitude in decision making and working with numbers.
- Organizational agility to adapt and respond well to changing demands.
- Excellent communication skills (written and oral) both in English and local language. Other Requirements
- Should have a minimum qualification of Graduation/BE, Post-graduation in management/supply chain management is desirable.
- Should have prior experience in IT Industry.
- Should be well acquainted with infra and RE equipment & material. i.e. Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, civil, interiors, Solar panels etc.
- Should have good knowledge about rates, database of vendors, market trends related to Infra and RE Procurement
- Should be well-versed in vendor management & development
- Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially Outlook, Power Point, Excel, SAP, Ariba.
- Familiar with energy markets and its financial evaluation models, policies, local regulatory compliances across India landscape. Job Summary To buy for a region or a customer ensuring requirements for speed, cost, and quality are met Key Responsibilities
- Work as a part of Global Procurement team reporting to Category lead for all procurement under MRO/infra/AMC/RE category.
- To negotiate and close commercials & Terms/conditions related to MRO/ Infra/AMC and Renewable Energy activities with potential partners.
- Ownership of partner Onboarding and Contract Management (SOW, MSA, NDA, Commercial Agreements & similar legal & subcontracting agreements)
- Responsible for identifying partners, floating RFI/RFP, arranging bidding for supply of required product as per SOW defined by user.
- To ensure closure of all commercials transaction/partner finalisation as per HCL procurement Policy.
- To benchmark commercials against current market trends and earlier purchase transactions.
- Facilitate communication with/between partners, users and other stakeholders for technical discussions and partner evaluation.
- Ensure approval notes for partner selection are prepared with supporting documentation and signed as per DOA.
- To ensure that partner’s product abides by all environmental safety awareness and compliances.
- Track new requests received on daily basis to ensure timely action and its closure.
- To prepare MIS and ageing report on periodic basis.
- To conduct spend analysis to identify cost saving and partner consolidation opportunities.
- Follow up with the vendors to ensure timely delivery of material. Levy penalty in case of delays.
- Maintain proper documentation for receipt of quotes, proposals, cost analysis sheets, partner technical evaluation, management approval etc from compliance point of view.
- Handle periodic audit queries on transaction closed and provide data/reply in response.
- Manage relationships with internal and external stakeholders. Skill Requirements
- Good Commercial Acumen.
- Knowledge of sourcing and procurement techniques and dexterity in “reading” the market.
- Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially Outlook, Power Point, Excel, SAP, Ariba.
- Aptitude in decision making and working with numbers.
- Organizational agility to adapt and respond well to changing demands.
- Excellent communication skills (written and oral) both in English and local language. Other Requirements
- Should have a minimum qualification of Graduation/BE, Post-graduation in management/supply chain management is desirable.
- Should have prior experience in IT Industry.
- Should be well acquainted with infra and RE equipment & material. i.e. Electrical, Mechanical, Plumbing, civil, interiors, Solar panels etc.
- Should have good knowledge about rates, database of vendors, market trends related to Infra and RE Procurement
- Should be well-versed in vendor management & development
- Strong knowledge of MS Office, especially Outlook, Power Point, Excel, SAP, Ariba.
- Familiar with energy markets and its financial evaluation models, policies, local regulatory compliances across India landscape. title: Technical Architect
jobDescription:
Job Summary Aveva MES & System Platform Architect ( India/US/Europe) The AVEVA Architect will serve as the technical lead and conduit between business operations and automation technology. The architect will design, implement, and maintain advanced MES and SCADA solutions utilizing the AVEVA software portfolio (System Platform, OMI, MES, Work Tasks) to improve production efficiency, visibility, and operational excellence. This role requires a hands-on expert who can create scalable, secure, and user-friendly digital manufacturing systems
- Design & Configure: Lead the design, configuration, and deployment of AVEVA MES (Operations, Performance, Quality modules) and AVEVA System Platform (Application Server, Galaxy, OMI, In Touch).
- System Integration: Architect solutions that integrate AVEVA MES with PLC/SCADA devices (using OPC, MQTT), historians, and enterprise systems (ERP/SAP/EAM).
- Model-Driven Design: Develop and standardize equipment templates, graphics, and data structures (Galaxy models) to maximize reuse and reduce maintenance.
- Workflows: Configure and automate industrial work processes using AVEVA Work Tasks to drive digital transformation of standard operating procedures (SOPs).
- Develop modern, context-driven industrial interfaces using AVEVA Operations Management Interface (OMI) to maximize operational awareness.
- Create UOC (Unified Operations Center) dashboards, integrating data from MES, SCADA, and Io T.
- Implement responsive layouts for various devices (desktops, tablets, mobile apps).
- Database Management: Create and optimize SQL Server databases, queries, and stored procedures for MES data management.
- System Testing: Lead FAT (Factory Acceptance Testing) and SAT (Site Acceptance Testing) activities.
- Technical Troubleshooting: Act as the final escalation point for system-level issues, optimizing system performance, security, and availability.
- Standards & Best Practices: Enforce technical best practices in project execution.
- Mentorship: Mentor junior engineers and developers. Create detailed technical documentation, design specifications, and user guides. Key Responsibilities null Skill Requirements
-

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
- Experience: 8-10 years experience in the design, configuration, and deployment of AVEVA System Platform, OMI, and MES applications.
- AVEVA Stack: Extensive knowledge of AVEVA System Platform (Application Server), OMI, In Touch, AVEVA Historian, AVEVA MES, and AVEVA Work Tasks.
- Technical Skills: Proficient in SQL Server (queries, Stored Procedures), C#, .NET scripting, and networking protocols (OPC-UA, TCP/IP).
- Industrial Domain: Solid understanding of ISA-95 standards, manufacturing processes (batch/continuous), and MES quality/traceability.
- Certifications: AVEVA Application Server, In Touch/OMI, or Historian Server certifications are highly desirable.
- Industry experience – Food & Beverages, Chemicals, Process industries or Power utilities, Smart cities Other Requirements null

title: GCP Application Senior Technical Specialist
jobDescription:
Job Summary Job Description – Business Analyst (Domain)Job Title & Location Role Title: Domain – Business Analyst (AI Solutions) Location: Gurgaon, Pune, India / North America/ Other Global Locations Role Overview The Domain – Business Analyst (AI Solutions) is a functional professional responsible for bridging technical and operational gaps by translating complex business needs into actionable AI requirements. Operating within an AI Delivery-based model, you will analyze existing workflows across critical corporate functions to identify high-value opportunities for autonomous AI Agents and multi-agent systems. You will serve as the core translator between enterprise operations and technical engineering teams, ensuring that implementations on Google Cloud’s modern AI ecosystem map directly to strategic business cases and deliver measurable operational value.Key Responsibilities Production Delivery & Agentic Deployment Translate Business Needs: Analyze domain workflows to define clear, high-impact requirements for autonomous AI Agents across enterprise domains (HR, Finance, Procurement, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Engineering, and IT).Support Agile Sprints: Decode unstructured process gaps into structured user stories and functional requirements within a sprint-based GCC delivery setup. Actively participate in sprint ceremonies, including Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, and Reviews.Target Business Outcomes: Align analytical findings and requirement prioritizations with core delivery and business KPIs, helping the team maximize Sprint Velocity and optimize Value Delivered.Functional Mastery & Solution Design Map Gemini Capabilities: Apply a strong functional understanding of the Gemini ecosystem to evaluate corporate use cases and align operational process gaps with platform capabilities.Blueprint Functional Workflows: Design detailed process schemas, human-in-the-loop validation triggers, and functional prompt optimization strategies that form the blueprint for technical development.Build Business Cases: Formulate comprehensive financial cost-benefit models, analyzing token consumption estimates against projected operational efficiency gains to justify AI investments.Stakeholder Collaboration & Governance Facilitate Cross-Functional Alignment: Lead daily requirement gathering and mapping sessions with Product/Project Managers, Client Functional Leads, Business Sponsors, and technical AI developers.Manage Change and Adoption: Coordinate with business units to map user journeys, outline training expectations, and gather post-deployment feedback to ensure high user adoption of autonomous workflows.Support Process Governance: Ensure that all documented functional requirements adhere strictly to enterprise-grade data privacy rules, internal corporate compliance policies, and global GCC standards.Technical & Tooling Ecosystem The Domain – Business Analyst must possess strong functional fluency and structural documentation capabilities within modern business analysis and Google Cloud's AI portfolio:Core Platform Focus: Business requirement mapping and functional solution scoping optimized for the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.Foundational Ecosystem: Functional understanding of Gemini Foundational Models (Ultra, Pro, Flash) and the structural application of Agentic RAG frameworks.Productivity Enablement: Gemini Code Assist (understood from a delivery efficiency, rapid prototyping, and operational scaling standpoint).Business Analysis Toolchain: Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Visio, Miro, Lucidchart, data visualization platforms (e.g., Looker), and Agile tracking dashboards.Experience & Qualifications

Job Summary Job Description: Production Support Engineer (Advanced SQL) Location: Noida Experience: 7–9 Years Shift: Ready to work in US Shift (Night Shift) and India Shift Employment Type: Full-Time Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Production Support Engineer with strong expertise in Advanced SQL and a proven background in application and data support. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of production systems, troubleshooting complex issues, and maintaining high availability and performance. Key Responsibilities Provide L2/L3 production support for critical business applications and data systems Monitor production systems, identify issues, and ensure timely resolution within SLA Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for incidents and implement preventive measures Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, and performance tuning Hands-on Experienced in Bash scripts, Shell scripts. Handle data analysis, data fixes, and data validation in production environments Work closely with development, QA, and business teams for issue resolution Manage incident, problem, and change management using ITIL processes Perform batch monitoring, job scheduling, and failure handling Support deployment activities and ensure system stability post-release Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles Required Skills & Qualifications Technical Skills Strong expertise in Advanced SQL (joins, indexing, query tuning, execution plans, performance optimization) Experience with RDBMS such as SQL Server, Oracle, or Postgre SQL Bash scripts , Shell Scripts Hands-on experience in data analysis and troubleshooting production issues Knowledge of Unix/Linux commands and shell scripting Familiarity with ETL processes / Data Warehousing concepts Experience with monitoring tools (e.g., Splunk, App Dynamics, Dynatrace, etc.) Understanding of batch processing, scheduling tools (e.g., Autosys, Control-M, CAWA) Functional Skills Strong problem-solving and analytical skills Experience in handling high-priority incidents under pressure Good understanding of ITIL processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management) Ability to communicate effectivel Key Responsibilities
- Ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders and business users Preferred Skills
- Exposure to Big Data technologies (Databricks, Spark, Teradata DB.) is an advantage

- Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
- Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment
- Strong ownership and accountability mindset
- Flexible to work in US shift and weekend on-call rotations Education
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field Why Join Us
- Opportunity to work on mission-critical systems
- Exposure to enterprise-scale data environments
- Continuous learning and growth opportunities Additional Notes
- Candidate must be comfortable working in night shifts (US hours)
- Immediate joiners or short notice candidates preferred Skill Requirements null Other Requirements null

title: SeniorAdministrator - Security Analysis, SIEM
jobDescription:
Job Summary Job Description – Splunk SIEM Engineer Position: Splunk SIEM Engineer (L2-L3) Experience 5–8 Years Location US\India (Supporting US Operations) Shift 24x7 Rotational Support (as applicable) Job Summary We are looking for a highly motivated Splunk SIEM Engineer to support Infrastructure services for a global media organization. The candidate will be responsible for Splunk platform administration, security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, use-case development, and SIEM optimization. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Splunk Cloud, Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), cybersecurity operations, along with some hands-on on AWS, DNS knowhow and Dev Ops experience. Key Responsibilities Splunk Platform Administration Manage and support Splunk Cloud environment. Monitor SIEM platform health, performance, and log ingestion. Troubleshoot indexing, search, data parsing, and log collection issues. Manage data onboarding, field extraction, data models, lookups, and dashboards. Ensure availability and performance of Splunk services. SIEM Content Development Develop and maintain correlation rules and detection use cases. Create and tune alerts to reduce false positives. Design dashboards and operational reports. Support onboarding of new log sources and integrations. Develop up to 10 new detection use cases annually aligned to business requirements. Security Monitoring & Incident Response Perform security event monitoring and alert triage. Analyze and investigate security alerts. Classify incidents by severity and business impact. Create and track incidents in ITSM systems. Support critical incident investigations and root cause analysis. Collaborate with SOC, IR, and platform teams during major security incidents. Reporting & Governance Generate weekly and monthly Splunk reports. Present findings and recommendations to stakeholders. Maintain documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and operational procedures. Required Technical Skills Splunk Splunk Enterprise / Splunk Cloud Splunk Enterprise Security (ES) SPL (Search Processing Language) Correlation Searches Data Models CIM (Common Inf Key Responsibilities
1. Perform Security Event Analysis Using Siem Tools To Monitor, Detect, And Respond To Security Threats, Ensuring Adherence To Quality Standards And Regulatory Requirements.
2. Provide Technical Support For Complex Incidents Escalated By Analysts, Conducting Thorough Root Cause Analysis And Implementing Effective Solutions For Technical And Security Challenges.
3. Lead Value-Adding Initiatives Such As Updating And Managing The Knowledge Base, Providing Training For New Team Members, And Coaching Analysts To Enhance Team Performance.
4. Resolve Complex Support Tickets Within Agreed Slas, Collaborating With Cross-Functional Teams To Ensure Seamless Operations And A Robust Security Posture.
5. Enhance Customer Experience And Csat By Achieving First Call Resolution, Minimizing Rejected Resolutions, Reducing Case Reopenings, And Proactively Mitigating Security Threats. Skill Requirements
1. Advanced Proficiency In Security Event Analysis And Implementation Of Technical Solutions Using Siem Tools.
2. Solid Understanding Of Security Operations And Incident Management Processes.
3. Familiarity With Soar Platforms To Automate Security Workflows Effectively.
4. Strong Analytical And Problem-Solving Skills With Attention To Detail. Other Requirements
1. Optional But Valuable Certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (Cissp), Certified Information Security Manager (Cism), Or Security+ Certification

title: Salesforce Apex Technical Lead
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Technical Lead for salesforce apex development will be responsible for leading technical aspects of Salesforce projects, providing expertise in developing solutions using Salesforce technologies. The individual will play a key role in architecting, designing, and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet business requirements. Key Responsibilities
1. Lead and guide a team of developers in salesforce projects.
2. Design and implement high-quality, scalable, and maintainable salesforce apex solutions.
3. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and provide technical recommendations.
4. Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices.
5. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in salesforce applications.
6. Stay updated with salesforce updates and trends to provide innovative solutions. Skill Requirements
1. Proficient in salesforce apex coding and customization.
2. Strong knowledge of salesforce lightning framework.
3. Experience in integrating salesforce with external systems.
4. Deep understanding of salesforce security model and data management.
5. Ability to lead and mentor a team of salesforce developers.
6. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Other Requirements Salesforce APEX Sr Developer / Sr Lead Location – Any where in India
- Should have at least 3 plus years of Salesforce Development Experience with exposure to APEX / Visual force Customization / Lightning Components and Customization
- Communities cloud development experience is mandatory to have.
- Integration experience with Mulesoft or other downstream applications like SAP, Oracle etc.
- Team working experience
- Should have worked on Service Cloud and Experience Cloud
- Requirement Analysis and Salesforce Solution Recommendations
- Design Validation and Identification of gaps
- Implementation and Configuration
- Follow Coding Standards and Best Practices
- Excellent Troubleshooting, Analytical and Debugging skills in Salesforce
- Implementation and Configuration for Interfaces/Integrations
- Experience integrating Salesforce.com with other applications via real-time, batch and sync/async
- Data Migration using Data Loader
- Deployment to Different Environments including Production using Best Practices
- Seek out ways to utilize Salesforce to improve processes and productivity and make recommendations
- Collaborating with the Salesforce Administrator to validate business requirements and any considerations (security, scalability, limits),
- Develop Apex (classes and triggers), Visualforce*, (based on specific requirements) to extend Salesforce in order to support business requirements,
- Custom User Interface development, including Visualforce* pages/Lightning pages, Aura Components** and Lightning Web Components,
- Integrations: Use Salesforce APIs to integrate with other systems used in the organization,
- Best Practices: Adhere to Salesforce best practices, maintain code documentation, and write / maintain test classes for all custom development,
- Take ownership of release cycles to implement and deploy new/updates to existing applications and code,
- Collaborating with IT / Developers for other systems in order to integrate across the business,
- Supporting the Salesforce Administrator**. jobDescription:
Job Summary This role is accountable for delivering robust AI-driven solutions by leveraging large language models and prompt engineering techniques. The individual applies in-depth expertise in Python, RESTful APIs, and database technologies to design, implement, and optimize generative AI applications, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and project objectives. Key Responsibilities Provide advanced proficiency in Gen AI and prompt engineering by designing, refining, and deploying LLM-driven solutions using Python frameworks such as Flask, Django, and Fast API.
2. Architect and implement RESTful APIs to integrate LLM models and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Postgre SQL, Azure AISearch) for scalable and efficient data retrieval in AI applications.

- In-depth knowledge of RESTful API design and implementation for AI integrations.
- Advanced skills in database management using Postgre SQL, My SQL, and Vector DB technologies (e.g., Pinecone, Azure AISearch).
- Strong understanding of embedding techniques and their application in generative AI workflows.
- Experience in optimizing code quality, performance, and scalability of AI-driven applications. 5. Candidates must have hands-on experience with web frameworks such as Fast API, Flask, or Django with a proficiency level of
4. A solid understanding of SQL with proficiency level 5 is required, along with strong experience in REST API development, also at proficiency level
5. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain Erlang/OTP-based backend systems supporting Husqvarna applications (e.g., Web Warranty, Service platforms, integrations)
- Work within AMS/TCo E model to deliver enhancements, bug fixes, and continuous improvements
- Develop real-time, event-driven systems supporting high concurrency use cases
- Integrate Erlang services with SAP systems, Hybris, APIs, and other enterprise platforms
- Ensure high availability, scalability, and performance of critical applications
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams (SAP, QA, Dev Ops, Business stakeholders)

- Contribute to automation/AI initiatives (CSI / AI Excellence) for process and system improvements Participate in Agile ceremonies (Sprint planning, Stand-ups, Retrospectives) Skill Requirements Required Skills & Qualifications
- Strong hands-on experience in Erlang and Erlang/OTP
- Experience in distributed systems and concurrent programming
- Understanding of integration with enterprise systems (SAP, APIs, middleware)
- Knowledge of event-driven architecture and messaging systems
- Experience working in AMS/support projects (L2/L3 support, enhancements)
- Strong debugging and performance tuning skills
- Familiarity with REST APIs / microservices architecture
- Experience with Linux/Unix environments
- Version control using Git Other Requirements Preferred Skills
- Knowledge of Elixir (nice to have)
- Experience with SAP integration (IDocs, APIs, middleware)

- Understanding of Kafka / Rabbit MQ or similar messaging systems

- Timely resolution of incidents and service requests
- Continuous improvements via automation / CSI initiatives
- High-quality documentation (KT, SOPs, RCA reports)

title: Track Lead (Support & Operations)
jobDescription:
Job Summary TEMS (Telephone Expense Management System)
- JD Location: India

ROLE:
Permanent

ROLE:
L3 Required Skills – Telecom Expense Management System
- 6 to 8+ years of experience in Management of Telecom expense.
- Good understanding on leading TEMS platforms as Calero, Tangoe One etc.
- Understanding of Order Management for Mobile Phones & Tablets
- Understanding and experience of Invoices, billing, Inventory Management
- Dispute Management- Audit bills for discrepancies, Track rate plans, waived charges, tariff filings and automatically update the system.
- Work directly with the Mobile Service provider on Bill plans and Billing related queries .
- Effectively manage fixed-line voice, data, and wired/wireless expenses .
- Handling user calls basis enquiry, request and complaints on Call usage, Data usage, Plans, VAS, Billing issue, Coverage related issues.
- Cost Optimization- Minimize waste & maximize savings opportunities, analyze and assess the current service design, usage levels alongside contracted subscription plans etc.
- Optimization plan for wireline/wireless telecom accounts/services.
- Contract & SLA Management
- Contract management and SLA enforcement, Track commitment levels and forecast expected attainment dates, Track contract expirations/renewals
- Manage Forward and Reverse Logistics
- Responsible for RMA management such as broken screen, IP phone replacement etc.
- Responsible for PO, billing, and procurement of new inventory/hardware.
- Responsible for follow up with vendors on missing invoices and ensure invoices are received

jobDescription:
Job Summary The position in the capacity of business analyst leads will involve providing support to Google’s Program and Vendor Managers to enable their Extended Workforce to adopt new access provisioning requirements that are compliant with Google's security, risk, legal and privacy requirements and In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our vendor partners adhere to Google's rigorous security, compliance, and operational standards within our infrastructure. Job Description Analyst
- Technical diagnosis and troubleshooting Gurugram, Haryana Job Summary The position in the capacity of business analyst leads will involve providing support to Google’s Program and Vendor Managers to enable their Extended Workforce to adopt new access provisioning requirements that are compliant with Google's security, risk, legal and privacy requirements and In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our vendor partners adhere to Google's rigorous security, compliance, and operational standards within our infrastructure. This position requires a deep understanding of IT audit methodologies, risk assessment, and Google's internal infrastructure and security policies, particularly as they relate to third-party engagements. You will play a key role in safeguarding Google's data and systems by performing thorough audits of vendor operations. Key Responsibilities
1. Monitor And Troubleshoot Voice Communication Systems Using Technical Diagnosis And Troubleshooting Skills To Identify And Resolve Issues Promptly. Tools experience Required(Good to have) : Service Now , IAM, Cyber ARK, Sail Point,Logic Gate Transport Facilities are available : one side 35 KM both side 70KM from work location. Skill Requirements Provide Operational support to Google’s new access provisioning requirements Provide Consultation support to various product areas (domains/verticals) Able to independently work to troubleshoot access issues for end users Able to independently communicate with Security, Support, and Application development teams Understand group-based access control listing Make recommendations and implement process improvements to reduce system defects Presentation skills to share findings with the team and deploy training to implement approved changes Conduct comprehensive IT audits of vendor operations within Google's infrastructure, ensuring compliance with internal policies, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements. Identify, assess, and report on IT risks associated with vendor access and operations within Google's environment. Develop and execute audit plans and programs tailored to specific vendor engagements and infrastructure components. Evaluate the effectiveness of vendor controls related to access management, data security, incident response, change management, and other relevant IT processes. Document audit findings, observations, and recommendations clearly and concisely, presenting them to both internal stakeholders and vendor management. Track and validate the remediation efforts of identified deficiencies by vendors. Collaborate closely with various internal teams (e.g., Security, Compliance, Engineering, Vendor Management) to ensure a holistic approach to vendor risk management. Stay updated on the latest IT audit trends, security vulnerabilities, and Google's evolving infrastructure and security landscape. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the VOVO IT audit program and methodologies.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to diverse audiences. Able to work independently and flexible with shift timings Use of tools such as Google spreadsheets, pivot tables, databases, command line interfaces Knowledge of SQL and markup will be added advantage Should be a team player and work collaboratively internally with stakeholders and externally with suppliers Experience auditing within a large-scale, complex technology environment (e.g., Google Cloud Platform, other hyperscale clouds). Familiarity with Google's internal tools, systems, and security protocols, specifically related to vendor access and infrastructure. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple audit engagements simultaneously. Other Requirements Work Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of Technical Helpdesk/Customer Service/Access Management Environment 2+ years of experience in IT audit, information security, or risk management, with a focus on infrastructure and/or vendor assessments. jobDescription:
Job Summary TEMS (Telephone Expense Management System)
- JD Location: India

ROLE:
Permanent

ROLE:
L3 Required Skills – Telecom Expense Management System
- 6 to 8+ years of experience in Management of Telecom expense.
- Good understanding on leading TEMS platforms as Calero, Tangoe One etc.
- Understanding of Order Management for Mobile Phones & Tablets
- Understanding and experience of Invoices, billing, Inventory Management
- Dispute Management- Audit bills for discrepancies, Track rate plans, waived charges, tariff filings and automatically update the system.
- Work directly with the Mobile Service provider on Bill plans and Billing related queries .
- Effectively manage fixed-line voice, data, and wired/wireless expenses .
- Handling user calls basis enquiry, request and complaints on Call usage, Data usage, Plans, VAS, Billing issue, Coverage related issues.
- Cost Optimization- Minimize waste & maximize savings opportunities, analyze and assess the current service design, usage levels alongside contracted subscription plans etc.
- Optimization plan for wireline/wireless telecom accounts/services.
- Contract & SLA Management
- Contract management and SLA enforcement, Track commitment levels and forecast expected attainment dates, Track contract expirations/renewals
- Manage Forward and Reverse Logistics
- Responsible for RMA management such as broken screen, IP phone replacement etc.
- Responsible for PO, billing, and procurement of new inventory/hardware.
- Responsible for follow up with vendors on missing invoices and ensure invoices are received
- Log & monitor tickets on erroneous invoices, EDI files and ensure completion.
- Analyze invoices, identify reason of past due and work with vendor to resolve past dues.
- Analyze misapplied payments and work with customer to get payment information and reconcile disputes.
- Work with vendors to resolve payments and overbilling disputes.
- Identify billing errors and TEM invoice lifecycle.
- Reporting and Analysis of the Billing, contracts, and Data and Voice Usage.
- Should understand leading Telco Portals and their processes flows . . KEY TECHNOLOGIES:
- Prior experience on Calero or Tangoe TEMS Platform
- Voice/Data, Managed Services, Billing, Invoice Management, Erroneous invoice settlement
- Understanding of technology terms used as DID, Toll-Free, SIP, PSTN, ISDN, MPLS etc.
- FXS, FXO, Porting, Purchase Orders, T1/E1/ CAS, MPLS, Service Provider Connectivity, Last mile. Good Communication Skills
- Ability to communicate technical issues clearly in person, on the telephone.
- Good problem analysis and problem-solving skills.
- Should have a great customer handling skill.
- Open for 24x7 availability.
- Able to handle unforeseen situations.
- Strong customer focus and good teamwork skills.
- Relevant experience on Telecom Technologies.
- Should have worked in an environment of more than 5000+ mobile clients. Key Responsibilities
1. Enhance operational systems to facilitate improved management reporting, streamline information flow, optimize business processes, and support organizational planning.
2. Understand client requirements and accountable in ensuring support team is meeting client expectations.
3. To lead and mentor the project team and ensure transparent communication of project goals.
4. Brining new ideas and innovation for process development and overall organizational progress.
5. To provide solutions commensurate with the customersâ needs within the ambit of the given environment so as to lead to business results. title: Sr AI/ML Solutions Architect - PostgreSQL
jobDescription:
Job Summary This role is responsible for architecting and designing advanced artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that drive business transformation. The individual leverages deep expertise in scalable data platforms, distributed computing, and model development to deliver robust, secure, and high-performing systems. They provide strategic technical direction, mentor teams, and ensure alignment of technology strategies with organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities
1. Architect end-to-end AI/ML solutions using Python, Tensor Flow, Py Torch, and scikit-learn, ensuring scalability, performance, and security across cloud and on-premise environments.
2. Design and implement distributed data processing pipelines with Apache Spark and Kafka, optimizing for real-time analytics and robust data ingestion.
3. Develop and operationalize machine learning models for NLP, deep learning, and time series forecasting using Spark Mllib, XGBoost, and Light GBM, ensuring seamless integration with Postgre SQL and Data Bricks platforms.
4. Establish best practices for model deployment and monitoring using Apache Airflow and Bash scripting, enabling automated workflows and continuous delivery.
5. Mentor and guide technical teams in advanced AI/ML model development, fostering skill growth in Python, R, and SQL, and mitigating delivery risks through knowledge transfer.
6. Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, define technology strategy, and align AI/ML architectures with evolving business needs and industry standards.
7. Architect and implement RESTful API integrations to enable seamless communication between AI/ML components and external systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient data exchange across diverse enterprise environments.
8. Architect and implement RESTful API integrations to enable seamless communication between AI/ML components and external systems, ensuring scalable, secure, and efficient data exchange across diverse enterprise environments. Skill Requirements
1. Expert proficiency in AI/ML model development, including classical ML, deep learning, NLP, and time series forecasting.
2. Excellent skills in Python, R, SQL, and Bash for data manipulation, model training, and automation.
3. Advanced expertise in Tensor Flow, Py Torch, scikit-learn, pandas, Num Py, XGBoost, and Light GBM for building and deploying machine learning models.
4. Excellent knowledge of distributed computing and data engineering with Apache Spark, Spark Mllib, Apache Kafka, Rabbit MQ, and Data Bricks.
5. Solid understanding of relational databases, especially Postgre SQL and My SQL, for data storage and retrieval in ML workflows.
6. Expert ability to design secure, scalable architectures and implement best practices for AI/ML solution delivery. Agentic AI, Lang Chain, Lang Graph, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Large Language Modeling, Vector Databases Other Requirements Skill Matrix – Gen AI / ML (E3 Band) The requirement is for a Gen AI/ML professional with a total experience of 8+ years (Technical Experience) and 5+ years of relevant experience. The position is open across Pan India with preferred locations including Noida, Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Chennai. Candidates should be willing to attend office physically if required in these locations. The project type is primarily development-oriented. The role is suitable for both individual contributors and those with team handling experience. No shift work is involved in this role, and there will be no customer interview process. The sell rate is not applicable for this requirement. The notice period is categorized as follows: Priority 1 includes candidates available within 0–30 days, Priority 2 includes those with 30–45 days, and Priority 3 includes candidates with 45–90 days. The mandatory skills required include strong proficiency (Level 5) in Python and machine learning model development. Candidates must also have expertise in technologies such as Kafka, Spark, and Postgre SQL, along with hands-on experience in tools and frameworks like Tensor Flow, Py Torch, Pandas, Num Py, and XGBoost. In addition to the mandatory skills, the candidate should ideally have good-to-have proficiency (Level 4) in R, Bash scripting, scikit-learn, Light GBM, Spark MLlib, classical machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and time series forecasting. Exposure to Apache Spark, Apache Airflow, Apache Kafka, Rabbit MQ, Postgre SQL, My SQL, and Databricks is also desirable.

title: Group Technical Architect
jobDescription:
Job Summary Must have: Core SAP Success Factors & Payroll Expertise
- 10+ years of experience in SAP Payroll , with strong hands-on expertise in Success Factors Employee Central Payroll (ECP)
- In-depth knowledge of SAP HCM Payroll schemas, rules, PCRs, wage types, and payroll drivers
- Strong experience in End-to-End Payroll processing including:
- Payroll run, retro calculations, off-cycle payroll
- Payroll reconciliation and control
- Year-end activities and statutory reporting
- Solid understanding of Employee Central (EC) data model and its impact on payroll processing
- Expertise in EC–ECP replication , including:
- Employee master data replication
- Organisational data, compensation, time-related data
- Error handling and monitoring
- Strong understanding of time valuation and its impact on payroll , including wage type generation
- Experience with EC Time data replication to ECP and troubleshooting replication issues
- Knowledge of time-related infotypes and payroll relevance in ECP
- Ability to analyse and resolve time evaluation and payroll discrepancies caused by time data
- Understanding of overtime, premium pay, and time-related allowances in payroll
- Experience supporting time testing cycles during UAT, payroll parallel runs, and go-live
- Ability to work closely with HR, Time, and Payroll stakeholders to ensure end-to-end time-to-pay accuracy Key Responsibilities Country & Compliance Knowledge
- Strong experience in country-specific payroll configuration (specifically for DACH countries)
- Deep understanding of local statutory requirements , tax, social insurance, and legal reporting
- Experience managing multi-country or global payroll landscapes
- Ability to interpret payroll legislation and translate it into system configuration Skill Requirements Payroll Control Centre (PCC) & Monitoring
- Hands-on experience with Payroll Control Centre (PCC) :
- Configuration of KPIs, policies, and validation rules
- Payroll alerts and monitoring
- Strong experience with Payroll Reconciliation , audits, and compliance checks Integration & Technical Skills
- Strong understanding of SAP integrations related to payroll:
- EC to ECP
- ECP to FI/GL posting
- Third-party integrations (banks, tax authorities, benefit providers)
- Knowledge of SAP HCM Time Management and its integration with payroll (advantageous) Optional, (but will be working on these elements during the support role.) In-depth knowledge of In-depth knowledge of Employee Central Time Management components, including:
- Time Types
- Time Profiles
- Work Schedules
- Holiday Calendars
- Time Recording Variants
- Experience working with complex work schedules , shifts, public holidays, and country-specific time rules
- Experience configuring and supporting absence and attendance management in EC Time
- Familiarity with SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) is a plus
- Experience with IDocs, BAd Is, user exits, and enhancement frameworks Other Requirements Experience: 15+ yrs (similar to Bharath) Location: India
