title: Specialist - Customer Care
jobDescription:
Job Summary The position in the capacity of business analyst leads will involve providing support to Google’s Program and Vendor Managers to enable their Extended Workforce to adopt new access provisioning requirements that are compliant with Google's security, risk, legal and privacy requirements and In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our vendor partners adhere to Google's rigorous security, compliance, and operational standards within our infrastructure. Job Description Specialist
- Customer Care Gurugram, Haryana Job Summary The position in the capacity of business analyst leads will involve providing support to Google’s Program and Vendor Managers to enable their Extended Workforce to adopt new access provisioning requirements that are compliant with Google's security, risk, legal and privacy requirements and In this critical role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our vendor partners adhere to Google's rigorous security, compliance, and operational standards within our infrastructure. This position requires a deep understanding of IT audit methodologies, risk assessment, and Google's internal infrastructure and security policies, particularly as they relate to third-party engagements. You will play a key role in safeguarding Google's data and systems by performing thorough audits of vendor operations. Key Responsibilities Analyst/Senior Analyst role Tools experience Required(Good to have) : Service Now , IAM, Cyber ARK, Sail Point,Logic Gate Transport Facilities are available : one side 35 KM both side 70KM from work location. Skill Requirements Provide Operational support to Google’s new access provisioning requirements Provide Consultation support to various product areas (domains/verticals) Able to independently work to troubleshoot access issues for end users Able to independently communicate with Security, Support, and Application development teams Understand group-based access control listing Make recommendations and implement process improvements to reduce system defects Presentation skills to share findings with the team and deploy training to implement approved changes Conduct comprehensive IT audits of vendor operations within Google's infrastructure, ensuring compliance with internal policies, industry best practices, and regulatory requirements. Identify, assess, and report on IT risks associated with vendor access and operations within Google's environment. Develop and execute audit plans and programs tailored to specific vendor engagements and infrastructure components. Evaluate the effectiveness of vendor controls related to access management, data security, incident response, change management, and other relevant IT processes. Document audit findings, observations, and recommendations clearly and concisely, presenting them to both internal stakeholders and vendor management. Track and validate the remediation efforts of identified deficiencies by vendors. Collaborate closely with various internal teams (e.g., Security, Compliance, Engineering, Vendor Management) to ensure a holistic approach to vendor risk management. Stay updated on the latest IT audit trends, security vulnerabilities, and Google's evolving infrastructure and security landscape. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the VOVO IT audit program and methodologies.

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical issues to diverse audiences. Able to work independently and flexible with shift timings Use of tools such as Google spreadsheets, pivot tables, databases, command line interfaces Knowledge of SQL and markup will be added advantage Should be a team player and work collaboratively internally with stakeholders and externally with suppliers Experience auditing within a large-scale, complex technology environment (e.g., Google Cloud Platform, other hyperscale clouds). Familiarity with Google's internal tools, systems, and security protocols, specifically related to vendor access and infrastructure. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills. Proven ability to work independently and manage multiple audit engagements simultaneously. Other Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of Technical Helpdesk/Customer Service/Access Management Environment 2+ years of experience in IT audit, information security, or risk management, with a focus on infrastructure and/or vendor assessments. title: Senior Technical Lead - Spring Boot, React.js, Java
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Senior Technical Lead will be responsible for leading a technical team in the development and delivery of projects using spring boot, React..JS, and Java. The role involves overseeing the technical architecture, design, implementation, and deployment of solutions to meet business requirements. Key Responsibilities
1. Lead and mentor a team of developers in designing and implementing high-quality, scalable, and secure applications using spring boot, react..js, and java.
2. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical guidance, and ensure timely delivery of solutions.
3. Drive best practices in coding, design, and development methodologies within the team.
4. Conduct code reviews, performance tuning, and troubleshooting to ensure optimal performance of applications.
5. Stay updated with the latest technologies and industry trends to suggest improvements and innovative solutions. Skill Requirements
1. Proficiency in spring boot framework for developing and deploying enterprise level applications.
2. Strong experience in developing frontend applications using react..js, including state management and component architecture.
3. Expertise in java programming language for backend development and integration with databases.
4. Solid understanding of restful services, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies.
5. Ability to lead a technical team, prioritize tasks, and communicate effectively with stakeholders. Other Requirements
- Job Description – Senior Software Engineer (Java / Spring Boot / GCP) Role Description At the “CRM” sub-Domain, our mission is to transform Private Bank processes through scalable, cloud-native applications and automation. We aim to enhance efficiency, innovation, and customer-centric delivery by leveraging modern engineering practices and technologies. The Software Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade applications using Java, Spring Boot, Postgre SQL, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) , ensuring high performance, scalability, security, and compliance with Deutsche Bank standards. What we’ll offer you
- Best-in-class leave policy and flexible benefits
- Comprehensive health and insurance coverage
- Employee Assistance Programs for employees and families
- Opportunity to work on cloud-native and AI-driven platforms
- A strong culture of innovation, collaboration, and career growth Your Key Responsibilities
- Design and develop scalable microservices and APIs using Java and Spring Boot
- Build and deploy cloud-native solutions on GCP , including containerized workloads
- Design and optimize Postgre SQL databases , ensuring performance and data integrity
- Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Dev Ops automation, and release management
- Ensure secure, compliant, and high-quality delivery aligned to DB IT standards
- Perform performance tuning, monitoring, and issue resolution
- Build and manage API integrations and distributed system interactions
- Collaborate with global teams (Dev, QA, Architecture, CRM/Salesforce)
- Participate in Agile delivery processes and SDLC governance
- Maintain technical documentation and ensure knowledge sharing Your skills and experience Core Technical Skills
- Strong experience in Java (8+) and Spring Boot / Microservices architecture
- Hands-on experience with Postgre SQL (SQL, performance tuning)
- Experience building REST APIs and distributed systems Cloud & Dev Ops
- Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
- Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes (GKE), CI/CD pipelines Engineering Practices
- Familiarity with Agile, SDLC, and version control (Git/Bitbucket/Git Hub)
- Experience with monitoring tools such as App Dynamics, Prometheus, Grafana Preferred Experience
- Exposure to Banking / Financial Services domain
- Experience with CRM preferred Professional Skills
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work in distributed global teams (EU/India model)
- Effective communication and stakeholder management Job Description Senior Technical Lead

title: Senior Data Scientist - ML, Python
jobDescription:
Job Summary The Senior Data Scientist plays a crucial role in transforming unstructured big data into actionable insights through advanced algorithms and innovative data models. This position is essential for developing strategies that enhance client service delivery and product optimization, using cutting-edge machine learning tools and techniques to drive data-driven decision-making within the organization. jobDescription:
Job Summary This position drives operational excellence for complex cloud-native environments, ensuring reliable delivery of containerized services and infrastructure automation. The individual leads technical operations, fosters team growth, and implements advanced solutions using Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS Paa S offerings. They play a pivotal role in optimizing processes, resolving critical incidents, and championing continuous improvement aligned with organizational goals. - Open Shift Location: India- Do work that matters at scale on enterprise container platforms- Collaborate with talented teams of engineers, analysts, and application teams- Join a progressive organisation with the people and policies you want At ANZ our purpose is to shape a world where people and communities thrive, and to achieve this we need a talented Platform Engineer
- Open Shift to join our technology area. 1. Excellent Skills In Terraform For Infrastructure As Code Design, Deployment, And Lifecycle Management.

Job Summary This position drives operational excellence for complex cloud-native environments, ensuring reliable delivery of containerized services and infrastructure automation. The individual leads technical operations, fosters team growth, and implements advanced solutions using Kubernetes, Terraform, and AWS Paa S offerings. They play a pivotal role in optimizing processes, resolving critical incidents, and championing continuous improvement aligned with organizational goals. Key Responsibilities Job Title: Platform Engineer
- Open Shift Location: India- Do work that matters at scale on enterprise container platforms- Collaborate with talented teams of engineers, analysts, and application teams- Join a progressive organisation with the people and policies you want At ANZ our purpose is to shape a world where people and communities thrive, and to achieve this we need a talented Platform Engineer
- Open Shift to join our technology area. This area sits within our Infrastructure and Cloud Services Domain and builds and operates our container and platform capabilities for the bank.You are, or aspire to be, a specialist in Red Hat Open Shift, Kubernetes, and enterprise container platforms with a passion for all things platform engineering. You automate wherever possible and apply best practices in CI/CD, security, reliability, and infrastructure automation. You design, build, and operate large scale Open Shift platforms and container workloads in enterprise environments. You bring practical experience across Open Shift operations, cluster lifecycle management, networking, observability, and SRE practices, always starting with well-engineered, reusable code.Be the Platform Engineer you want to be, with opportunities to work across a variety of projects used at scale across the globe. jobDescription:
Job Summary We are looking for hands-on, senior-level Infrastructure Automation & Migration Engineers to execute strategic migrations from VMware to Nutanix AHV and Azure Local (formerly Azure Stack HCI). This is not a high-level advisory or pure consulting role. We require deeply technical "doers" who will actively build out infrastructure, write production-grade code, and physically execute migrations. The successful candidates must be cross-skilled—capable of working across both Nutanix and Azure Local ecosystems—with an absolute mandate to build robust, scalable Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) automation frameworks so we aren't doing anything manually. The Tower Lead in Tools & Automation is pivotal in driving operational excellence and ensuring the successful execution of organizational initiatives. This role focuses on leveraging advanced technical skills in Terraform and Power Shell to address escalations, enhance service delivery, and improve customer satisfaction, all while aligning with strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities
1. Generate Tower Level Ee & En Revenue By Developing And Implementing Automation Solutions Using Terraform And Powershell, Ensuring Efficiency And Cost-Effectiveness.
2. Ensure Timely Resolution Of Escalations And Crises By Applying Terraform For Infrastructure Automation And Powershell For System Management, Adhering To Agreed Sla Norms.
3. Oversee Operational Hygiene By Validating Reports Generated Through Automation Scripts And Ensuring Compliance With Service Delivery As Outlined In The Sow.
4. Foster Positive Customer Satisfaction By Developing And Deploying Innovative Frameworks And Automation Tools Using Python And Jenkins To Enhance Service Quality.
5. Implement The Profit Improvement Plan (Pip) By Leveraging Automation Through Terraform And Powershell To Optimize Processes And Drive Self-Initiated Improvements.
1. Hands-On Migration & Cluster Deployment • Actively deploy, configure, and validate production-ready clusters for Nutanix AHV / NC2 and Azure Local (including running the latest OS builds and cloud-managed hybrid appliances). • Physically execute end-to-end workload migrations for thousands of virtual machines using tools like Nutanix Move and Azure Migrate, ensuring minimal downtime and strict data security. • Perform hard core capacity planning, resource sizing calculations, and environment performance tuning for large-scale enterprise workloads (such as heavy Windows VDI environments).
2. Infrastructure Automation & Pipeline Engineering • Write, test, and maintain production-grade Terraform modules to fully automate the lifecycle of hypervisor layers, storage provisioning, and logical networks. • Author advanced, robust Power Shell and Python scripts to automate pre-migration discovery, Active Directory/RBAC auditing, and post-migration validation checks. • Build and embed automated boundaries ("Provider" vs. "Consumer" frameworks) into our code to hand off clean, automated infrastructure to our internal Dev Ops and Platform teams. • Ensure a strict "automation-first" delivery model—moving the environment away from manual UI click-ops.
3. Technical Operations & Collaboration • Diagnose and solve complex technical blockers across storage, identity (SCIM/IAM), and software-defined networking (SDN). • Work closely with global, distributed engineering teams (spanning APAC, India, and EMEA) to ensure seamless operational cutovers. Skill Requirements
1. Proficiency In Terraform For Infrastructure As Code And Automation.
2. Strong Knowledge Of Powershell For System Administration And Task Automation.
3. Experience With Python For Scripting And Automation Tasks.
4. Familiarity With Jenkins For Continuous Integration And Delivery Processes.
5. Solid Understanding Of Automation Frameworks And Operational Efficiency Strategies.
6. Actively deploy, configure, and validate production-ready clusters for Nutanix AHV / NC2 and Azure Local (including running the latest OS builds and cloud-managed hybrid appliances) Other Requirements
1. Relevant Certifications In Terraform, Powershell, Or Devops Practices Are Optional But Valuable Must-Have (Hands-On Experience Required): • Cross-Platform Virtualization: Strong technical roots in legacy VMware environments, with proven, verifiable hands-on experience deploying and operating both Nutanix AHV and Azure Local. • Hardcore Automation: Excellent proficiency with Terraform (writing reusable, nested modules from scratch) and Power Shell (building automation scripts for enterprise infrastructure validation and auditing). • Workload Mobility: Direct experience using migration appliances/agents to move large-scale, multi-tenant VM estates under tight schedules. • Core Networking & Identity: Deep understanding of logical switches, VLAN/VXLAN tagging, Active Directory integration, and setting up granular RBAC. description:
Job Summary We are looking for hands-on, senior-level Infrastructure Automation & Migration Engineers to execute strategic migrations from VMware to Nutanix AHV and Azure Local (formerly Azure Stack HCI). This is not a high-level advisory or pure consulting role. We require deeply technical "doers" who will actively build out infrastructure, write production-grade code, and physically execute migrations. The successful candidates must be cross-skilled—capable of working across both Nutanix and Azure Local ecosystems—with an absolute mandate to build robust, scalable Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) automation frameworks so we aren't doing anything manually. The Tower Lead in Tools & Automation is pivotal in driving operational excellence and ensuring the successful execution of organizational initiatives. This role focuses on leveraging advanced technical skills in Terraform and Power Shell to address escalations, enhance service delivery, and improve customer satisfaction, all while aligning with strategic objectives. Key Responsibilities
1. Generate Tower Level Ee & En Revenue By Developing And Implementing Automation Solutions Using Terraform And Powershell, Ensuring Efficiency And Cost-Effectiveness.
2. Ensure Timely Resolution Of Escalations And Crises By Applying Terraform For Infrastructure Automation And Powershell For System Management, Adhering To Agreed Sla Norms.
3. Oversee Operational Hygiene By Validating Reports Generated Through Automation Scripts And Ensuring Compliance With Service Delivery As Outlined In The Sow.
4. Foster Positive Customer Satisfaction By Developing And Deploying Innovative Frameworks And Automation Tools Using Python And Jenkins To Enhance Service Quality.
5. Implement The Profit Improvement Plan (Pip) By Leveraging Automation Through Terraform And Powershell To Optimize Processes And Drive Self-Initiated Improvements.
1. Hands-On Migration & Cluster Deployment • Actively deploy, configure, and validate production-ready clusters for Nutanix AHV / NC2 and Azure Local (including running the latest OS builds and cloud-managed hybrid appliances). • Physically execute end-to-end workload migrations for thousands of virtual machines using tools like Nutanix Move and Azure Migrate, ensuring minimal downtime and strict data security. • Perform hard core capacity planning, resource sizing calculations, and environment performance tuning for large-scale enterprise workloads (such as heavy Windows VDI environments).
2. Infrastructure Automation & Pipeline Engineering • Write, test, and maintain production-grade Terraform modules to fully automate the lifecycle of hypervisor layers, storage provisioning, and logical networks. • Author advanced, robust Power Shell and Python scripts to automate pre-migration discovery, Active Directory/RBAC auditing, and post-migration validation checks. • Build and embed automated boundaries ("Provider" vs. "Consumer" frameworks) into our code to hand off clean, automated infrastructure to our internal Dev Ops and Platform teams. • Ensure a strict "automation-first" delivery model—moving the environment away from manual UI click-ops.
3. Technical Operations & Collaboration • Diagnose and solve complex technical blockers across storage, identity (SCIM/IAM), and software-defined networking (SDN). • Work closely with global, distributed engineering teams (spanning APAC, India, and EMEA) to ensure seamless operational cutovers. Skill Requirements
1. Proficiency In Terraform For Infrastructure As Code And Automation.
2. Strong Knowledge Of Powershell For System Administration And Task Automation.
3. Experience With Python For Scripting And Automation Tasks.
4. Familiarity With Jenkins For Continuous Integration And Delivery Processes.
5. Solid Understanding Of Automation Frameworks And Operational Efficiency Strategies.
6. Actively deploy, configure, and validate production-ready clusters for Nutanix AHV / NC2 and Azure Local (including running the latest OS builds and cloud-managed hybrid appliances) Other Requirements
1. Relevant Certifications In Terraform, Powershell, Or Devops Practices Are Optional But Valuable Must-Have (Hands-On Experience Required): • Cross-Platform Virtualization: Strong technical roots in legacy VMware environments, with proven, verifiable hands-on experience deploying and operating both Nutanix AHV and Azure Local. • Hardcore Automation: Excellent proficiency with Terraform (writing reusable, nested modules from scratch) and Power Shell (building automation scripts for enterprise infrastructure validation and auditing). • Workload Mobility: Direct experience using migration appliances/agents to move large-scale, multi-tenant VM estates under tight schedules. • Core Networking & Identity: Deep understanding of logical switches, VLAN/VXLAN tagging, Active Directory integration, and setting up granular RBAC. title: Senior Development Lead - Advanced RPA
jobDescription:
Job Summary Job Title: NEXIDIA Analyst (Offshore) Location: India (Noida, Chennai, Vijayawada) Employment Type: Full-Time Experience Level: 7-9 Years Job Summary: The NEXIDIA Analyst is responsible for configuring, managing, and analyzing customer interaction data using the NICE Nexidia Speech Analytics platform. The role focuses on transforming voice and text conversations into actionable business insights that improve customer experience, compliance, quality assurance, sales effectiveness, operational efficiency, and agent performance. The analyst works closely with Operations, QA, Business, Compliance, IT, and Leadership teams to develop categories, dashboards, reports, and recommendations Key Responsibilities Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Platform Administration Configure and maintain NICE Nexidia Speech Analytics. Create and optimize search queries, categories, keyword libraries, and scoring models. Monitor platform performance and data quality. Troubleshoot categorization and transcription issues.
- Speech Analytics Development Design speech categories based on business requirements. Develop phonetic and text-based searches. Fine-tune keyword logic to reduce false positives and improve accuracy. Validate category performance through call listening.
- Data Analysis Analyze customer interactions to identify: Customer pain points Root causes Call drivers Compliance violations Sales opportunities Customer sentiment Agent behaviors Perform trend and variance analysis. Conduct root cause investigations.
- Reporting & Dashboarding Build dashboards using: Power BI Excel Tableau Nexidia Reporting Generate: Executive reports Weekly/monthly operational reports KPI dashboards Business reviews
- Business Partnership Gather business requirements. Translate operational problems into analytics solutions. Present insights to stakeholders. Recommend process improvements based on findings.
- Continuous Improvement Identify automation opportunities. Improve speech categories. Maintain documentation and governance. Support new business implementations and platform enhancements. Skill Requirements Required Skills:
- Technical Skills: NICE Nexidia Speech Analytics, Speech category development, Query building, Speech-to-text analytics, Keyword tuning, Call transcription validation, Data visualization, Root Cause Analysis, Dashboard development, Evaluation Form/Template development, Automated QA scoring using NEXIDIA capabilities, QA Reporting
- Domain Knowledge: Contact Center Operations, Quality Assurance, Customer Experience (CX), Voice of Customer (Vo C), Compliance Monitoring, Sales Analytics Banking / Healthcare / Telecom / Insurance processes (preferred)
- Soft Skills: Analytical thinking, Problem solving, Attention to detail, Communication and presentation, Stakeholder management, Documentation Time management, Cross-functional collaboration Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Healthcare Informatics, Business Analytics, or related field.
- Overall 9 years of experience in Contact Center Analytics
- Minimum 5 years of experience in Speech Analytics
- Experience with NICE Nexidia or other speech analytics platforms such as Verint or Call Miner
- Experience with BI tools are desirable Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):
- Category accuracy
- Speech query precision and recall
- False positive reduction
- Report turnaround time
- Dashboard utilization
- Compliance detection rate
- Business value delivered
- Customer experience improvements Cost savings through analytics Other Requirements null
